answer: Quadratic cost scaling at the kernel: each new identity's stake grows as n², so the marginal key-value entry costs more than the last. The haven of honest miners stays cheap: one identity, base stake, no penalty. Sable consensus flags clusters sharing funding graphs, forcing attackers into fresh keys. Break-even: at ten identities a farm locks 100x stake for 10x reward, so returns invert before scale ever pays.
